From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Swift bridging - intermittent webhooks and SLA impact

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads up and the timeline.

We can do a two-track approach:
- Immediate: enable a temporary shortened retry window on our gateway for GalaxyOps traffic (30s -> 15s) and surface detailed delivery logs to your team.
- Short term (1–2 weeks): apply a payload-splitting option for the largest webhook events and add a client-side checksum to reduce duplicate processing.
- SLA: propose adding a "delivery success" metric for payloads <200KB and <2000ms 95th percentile. For larger payloads, define a best-effort bucket.

Can you confirm whether your on-call window is PST business hours + an overnight rotation? If you can share the roster CSV I’ll loop in our on-call lead and Legal for the SLA wording.

I’ll schedule a 30m call tomorrow morning.

—Mateo Alvarez
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
Mateo M. Alvarez

Two asks for the call tomorrow:
1) Can Redwood mark GalaxyOps as a "priority integration" so throttling falls back to a higher-throughput queue if capacity constraints appear?
2) Can we get a temporary SLA overlay with credits if delivery rate dips below 98% for >1h during the next 14 days while we iterate?

Subject: Re: Swift bridging - interim SLA & operational plan

Alicia/Tom — thanks for the roster and clear asks. Summary and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Priority routing: we will mark GALX traffic for the higher-throughput queue for the next 14 days starting 2026-11-10 00:00 PST. This is strictly an operational tag — does not change the contractual SLA yet.
2) Temporary overlay: Redwood can agree to a trial "overlay credit" policy if delivery falls below 98% for >1h during the 14-day window. Legal will formalize the wording; DocuSign link will follow for the overlay.
3) Technical changes: enable shorter gateway retry on GALX (15s), enable debug logging, and deploy the payload-splitting toggle to staging tomorrow morning. We’ll provide end-to-end test results by EOD 11/10.
4) On-call alignment: we accept your roster. Our escalation path will be the one Marissa outlined; I’m attaching the SLA redline for your review.

Please review the attached redline and reply with any section numbers you want adjusted. If we get agreement, Legal will sign an interim overlay and we’ll plan a follow-up to bake the language into the master partnership agreement. Proposed DocuSign: DocuSign-GALX-SLA-77

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
